claim: Almaviva, Don Melchor, Viñedo Chadwick — the 2004 Berlin Tasting's winners grew here.
because: At the Berlin Tasting of 23 January 2004 the top two were Viñedo Chadwick 2000 (first) and Seña 2001 (second). Seña is an Aconcagua wine, not a Puente Alto wine. Neither Almaviva nor Don Melchor placed among the winners. Of the three wines the explanation names, only Viñedo Chadwick won.
fix: Almaviva, Don Melchor and Viñedo Chadwick all grow here; Viñedo Chadwick 2000 took first place at the 2004 Berlin Tasting (Seña 2001, from Aconcagua, was second).
